title: OTHRYS OS tablet inspector compaction
goal: Use the live tablet screenshot to remove wasted vertical and horizontal space while preserving all current work evidence.
laws: Cards must size to content instead of stretching into empty slabs.
The tablet Work inspector must not waste width on a redundant one-item chat rail.
All Progress, Plan, phase and evidence content remains reachable.
No mission, model, Trust Canal or execution semantics change.
No external assets or proprietary Panda code are introduced.
Existing read-only and Refine boundaries remain unchanged.
